assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Parallel lines l and m cut by a transversal t at P and Q, with X on t beyond P, A on l and B on m to the right; the angle XPA is marked alpha, and a dashed line m' through Q and B' makes the same angle alpha with t.

difficulty_rationale: Requires seeing that the theorem follows from the uniqueness of parallels, by constructing the line that makes the equal angle.
